snippet.title: Whispers of Orange Island — Demo Coming Oct. 1
snippet.description:
Help wandering spirits reach their destinations in a 2D stealth puzzle game where the people around you are more than obstacles. Learn their routines, exploit relationships, use ancestral tools, and piece together 100 years of intertwined lives on an island that lives by night.

🎮 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5165730...

Demo: October 1, 2026
Full Game: December 2026

#WhispersOfOrangeIsland #IndieGame #GameTrailer #IndieGameDev
